Running command: cd /tmp && python3 -c "
import struct

# DFont tag
data = bytearray()

# ResourceForkHeader (16 bytes)
data += struct.pack('>I', 0)   # data offset = 0
data += struct.pack('>I', 16)  # map offset = 16
data += struct.pack('>I', 0)   # dataLen = 0
data += struct.pack('>I', 28)  # mapLen = 28

# ResourceMap (28 bytes) at offset 16
data += b'\x00' * 16  # reserved0
data += struct.pack('>I', 0)  # reserved1
data += struct.pack('>H', 0)  # resreved2
data += struct.pack('>H', 0)  # attrs
data += struct.pack('>H', 28) # typeList offset = 28 (points to type list after map)
data += struct.pack('>H', 0)  # nameList

# Type list at offset 44
data += struct.pack('>H', 0)  # lenM1 = 0 (1 type record)
# Type record (8 bytes)
data += b'sfnt'               # tag
data += struct.pack('>H', 0)  # resCountM1 = 0 (1 resource)
data += struct.pack('>H', 8)  # resourcesZ offset = 8 (points to resource record after type record)

# Resource record (12 bytes) at offset 52
data += struct.pack('>H', 0)  # id
data += struct.pack('>h', -1) # nameOffset
data += struct.pack('>B', 0)  # attrs
data += struct.pack('>I', 0)[1:]  # offset (3 bytes) = 0
data += struct.pack('>I', 0)  # reserved

open('/tmp/dfont_test.bin', 'wb').write(data)
print('size:', len(data))
"
/tmp/hb_shape_fuzzer /tmp/dfont_test.bin 2>&1 | head -30
